product.title: Authentic Private Everglades Airboat Tour

description.text: Explore Florida's Everglades on a private airboat tour designed for small groups seeking a personalized wildlife experience. Glide through sawgrass marshes with a local captain, watch for alligators and native birds, and learn about the ecosystem at a relaxed pace.

highlights: Private airboat experience for your party only
Spot alligators, turtles, and native birdlife in the Everglades
Learn from a local captain about wetlands ecology and conservation
Convenient Fort Lauderdale departure for a half-day adventure

start.description: Meet your captain at the designated Everglades launch location near Fort Lauderdale. Full meeting details are provided after booking.

itineraryItems.title: Meet your private captain
itineraryItems.description: Check in at the launch point and review safety guidance before departure.

itineraryItems.title: Private airboat ride through the wetlands
itineraryItems.description: Cruise across the marsh while your guide points out wildlife and habitat zones.

itineraryItems.title: Wildlife spotting and photo stops
itineraryItems.description: Pause in scenic areas for photos and sightings of Everglades species.

additionalInfo: Tour duration may vary slightly due to weather and water conditions
Wear comfortable clothes suitable for outdoor conditions
Children must be accompanied by an adult

faqs.question: Is this tour private?
faqs.answer: Yes. The airboat is reserved for your booking party only.

faqs.question: How long is the experience?
faqs.answer: The tour is approximately 1 hour 30 minutes, including check-in and on-water time.

faqs.question: What wildlife might we see?
faqs.answer: Sightings can include alligators, turtles, wading birds, and other Everglades wildlife.
